title: Sunday · the Rain, 2016
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: Nineteenth January. The sill with three jars. The lamp on, then off. The pup in the bed — the old one, for the first time.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the casement window from inside, rain in resist, three jars on the sill: brushes, nibs, the sand dollar. The alley a blur.

image.prompt: a small casement window from inside a garage studio with rain streaking the glass in watercolor resist, three jars on the sill holding brushes, nibs and a sand dollar, no figures

panels.name: The sill

panels.composition: Tier 2: the drafting table, the lamp on, the chair empty. Under the table: the old braided bed — and in it, curled, the three-legged pup. The first time he uses it.

image.prompt: a drafting table under a rainy window with its lamp on and chair empty, and beneath it a wiry three-legged dog curled asleep in an old braided dog bed, watercolor
image.notes: First time the pup uses the old bed. No comment.

panels.name: The bed

panels.composition: Tier 3: lamp off. Blue window light. The pup still in the bed. Silent.

image.prompt: the same drafting table with the lamp off and cold blue rain-light across it, a three-legged dog asleep in the bed beneath, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Blue

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: The 2006 Rain's framing, ten years on. The pup takes the bed.
